newClosureHandoff.scope: Separate point-in-time exact-birth absence proof; original pipeline HALTED/quiet=false is unchanged

recordedGuardTailSurvivors.scope: Recorded guard-tail observation only; not a fresh current-process presence check

processIdentity.key: Exact recorded PID plus parsed UTC birth ticks
processIdentity.processProofBirthQualification: PowerShell JSON proof timestamps have millisecond precision; role binding requires unique PID/birth match within2ms and never merges sampled identities

qualifications: Original pipeline HALTED/quiet=false remains verbatim and SHA-pinned. Only a separate reviewed HANDOFF SHA with CLOSURE_PROVEN/quiet=true allows this observation collection; it never changes recorded outcomes.
Guard COMPLETED is not product PASS, CLEAN, absence of all descendants or successful recovery.
Full test outcome belongs only to the separately retained terminal phase result.
Only identities already recorded by the owned guard/proof are summarized; no CIM or unrelated-process inventory is performed.
No fresh survivor check is performed. The guard tail may precede outer phase closure.
One-second nominal sampling includes CIM overhead and can miss peaks.
Windows aggregate pressure does not identify a user activity or process as its cause.
Source handles deny write/delete sharing during collection; path metadata and byte hashes are revalidated; physical file IDs are not measured.
ReadLine validates a post-read row length; one malformed row can allocate up to the source file byte cap before refusal.
All original evidence remains private and untouched; publication still requires independent privacy review.
